effects.description: Shapes drop in when the box scrolls into view, scroll speed shakes them, and you can drag them or click to add more.

effects.name: swipe-deck
effects.title: Swipe deck
effects.description: While pinned, each wheel turn, swipe or arrow key moves exactly one slide with a full-screen transition. After the last slide the page scrolls on.

effects.name: lag-and-speed
effects.title: Lag + speed columns
effects.description: Switch the header menu to ScrollSmoother and these columns use data-speed and data-lag. In native mode the same look comes from ScrollTrigger.

effects.name: one-dataset-three-shapes
effects.title: One dataset, three shapes
effects.description: The same real numbers morph from a stacked area, to grouped bars, to a 100% share chart as the story moves on.

effects.name: globe
effects.title: Globe that turns to the story
effects.description: A real world map on an orthographic globe: scroll spins it from Córdoba to Mexico, Chile and New York, drawing the routes.

effects.name: css-only
effects.title: Six effects, zero scripts
effects.description: Each box scrolls on its own and runs on the browser’s native scroll timelines: animation-timeline: scroll() and view().

effects.name: view-transition-cards
effects.title: Card to detail
effects.description: Click a card: the browser morphs it into the detail view. Click back and it morphs home. No animation library.

effects.name: progress-tracker
effects.title: Progress tracker with checkpoints
effects.description: Six activities follow. Each one ticks off here when you finish it, and your progress is remembered on this device, so a long page can be a course you come back to.
effects.ld: A long scroll page becomes a module: learners see what’s left, pick up where they stopped, and the certificate unlocks at the end.

effects.name: knowledge-check
effects.title: Knowledge check
effects.description: Three questions with feedback right after each answer, an explanation either way, and a score at the end.
effects.ld: Drop one after each chapter to check understanding before moving on. The explanation turns a wrong answer into a teaching moment.

effects.name: branching-scenario
effects.title: Branching scenario
effects.description: A short conversation where your choices change what happens next. A meter tracks how the conversation is going and the path you took stays visible.
effects.ld: Soft skills, sales calls, customer service, compliance: practise a hard conversation safely and see the consequences of each choice.

effects.name: flashcards
effects.title: Flashcards with spaced repetition
effects.description: Flip a card, then say whether you knew it. Cards you miss come back sooner; the deck is done when you know them all.
effects.ld: Vocabulary, product names, procedures, safety rules: short daily practice that adapts to what each person still needs.

effects.name: sort-it-out
effects.title: Sort it out
effects.description: Is each effect driven by scroll or not? Drag the chips into a box, or tap a chip and then tap a box. Check when you’re ready.
effects.ld: Classification is a strong way to practise judgement: risks vs safe actions, needs vs wants, the right tool for each job.

effects.name: video-question
effects.title: Video that asks a question
effects.description: The film pauses at a marked moment and asks you something. Answer to continue. The pink dot on the bar shows where the question is.
effects.ld: Keeps learners active during video: check they noticed the key moment instead of letting it play in the background.

effects.name: glossary
effects.title: Glossary on demand
effects.description: Underlined terms open a short definition on hover, focus or tap. Open three to complete the activity.
effects.ld: Experts read on; newcomers get help in place. No one leaves the page to look things up.

effects.name: certificate
effects.title: Certificate
effects.description: Type your name and the certificate draws itself with today’s date and your results. Download it as a picture.
effects.ld: A clear end point for a module, something to share, and a record of what was completed.

effects.name: word-reveal
effects.title: Word-by-word reveal
effects.description: Words light up in step with scroll, so reading speed follows scrolling speed.

effects.name: velocity-marquee
effects.title: Velocity marquee
effects.description: Two rows of giant type speed up with your scroll and flip direction with it.

effects.name: sticky-card-stack
effects.title: Sticky card stack
effects.description: Each card pins, the next lands on top, and the one below shrinks back.

effects.name: colour-flow
effects.title: Colour flow
effects.description: The background glides between colours as each band reaches the middle, blended in OKLab through a registered CSS property.

effects.name: dot-field
effects.title: Reactive dot field
effects.description: A canvas of dots that parts around the pointer and waves with scroll speed.

effects.name: compare-hotspots
effects.title: Compare, hotspots, lens
effects.description: Drag to compare the assembled and exploded slide, tap the numbered dots, hover to magnify.

effects.name: zoom-through
effects.title: Zoom-through
effects.description: “190+” scales around the stroke of its zero until the zero fills the screen.

effects.name: dot-portal
effects.title: Dot portal
effects.description: A dot grows into a circle that becomes the next room.

effects.name: film-scrub
effects.title: Film scrubbed by scroll
effects.description: The engine film from Chapter 4. Scroll is the playhead; the file is loaded once as a blob so seeking is instant even on hosts that ignore byte ranges.

effects.name: film-labels
effects.title: Labels that track a film
effects.description: From Chapter 5: a 3D render exported with the screen position of six points per frame, so HTML labels stick to objects as the film plays.

effects.name: kinetic-type
effects.title: Kinetic type
effects.description: From Chapter 3: three words swap through masked letters while a ball rides a spiral and lands in the slot of the last word.

effects.name: prezi-camera
effects.title: Prezi-style camera
effects.description: From Chapter 8: one big map; scroll flies the camera between stops, dips out between them, rotates for a tilted frame and dives into a tiny secret. Snaps to each stop.

effects.name: map-flight
effects.title: Map flight
effects.description: From Chapter 10: a real world map pans and zooms between cities while the route draws and a plane follows it.

effects.name: waffle-morph
effects.title: Waffle + shape morph
effects.description: From Chapter 11: a hundred dots regroup and an icon morphs into another shape at each step.
effects.note: Sample split; the morph needs MorphSVGPlugin.

effects.name: serpentine-timeline
effects.title: Serpentine timeline
effects.description: From Chapter 13: a winding path draws itself as you read; a dot rides the line and each stop lights as it passes.

effects.name: sideways-chapter
effects.title: Sideways chapter with skew
effects.description: From Chapter 14: vertical scroll drives a horizontal strip; cards lean with scroll speed, their art drifts inside them, and it snaps to each card. On phones it becomes a swipeable strip.

effects.name: scrubbed-counter
effects.title: Scrubbed counter
effects.description: From Chapter 9: a big number climbs with scroll and rewinds when you scroll back.

effects.name: chapter-chip
effects.title: Chapter chip that decodes
effects.description: The Story’s chapter label: a sticky chip that scrambles into the name of the section you reach.

effects.name: preview-cards
effects.title: Preview clips in context
effects.description: The same effects inside the full narrative. Each preview was recorded from Part 2; open the chapter to drive it yourself.

effects.name: hide-on-scroll-header
effects.title: Hide-on-scroll header
effects.description: The top bar slides away while you scroll down and comes back the moment you scroll up.

effects.name: chapter-pills
effects.title: Category pills + progress bar
effects.description: The active pill follows your position; a thin coral line under the header shows how far through the page you are.

effects.name: progress-ring
effects.title: Progress ring
effects.description: The round button in the corner fills as you go. Click it to glide back up.

effects.name: curtain-footer
effects.title: Curtain footer
effects.description: The page lifts at the end like a curtain to reveal the footer that was waiting underneath.

reference.title: Batch fade-up
reference.description: Tiles arrive in groups with a stagger as they enter, never one at a time.

reference.title: Clip-path wipe
reference.description: An image is uncovered left to right, tied to scroll.

reference.title: Circle reveal
reference.description: A circular window grows from the centre until it is the whole frame.

reference.title: Curtain split
reference.description: Two halves slide apart to show what was behind them. Pinned while it happens.

reference.title: Blur to focus
reference.description: A soft, oversized frame sharpens and settles as you scroll.

reference.title: Assemble from chaos
reference.description: Squares fly in from random places and settle into a grid that spells a shape.

reference.title: Fill on scroll
reference.description: Outlined letters fill with colour, left to right, as you read down.

reference.title: Scattered letters
reference.description: Characters start flung across the frame and fall into place.

reference.title: Text on a path
reference.description: A sentence travels along a wave; scroll moves it along the line.

reference.title: Scramble in
reference.description: Lines decode from noise the first time they come into view.

reference.title: Odometer
reference.description: Each digit is a reel that spins to its value.

reference.title: Marker highlight
reference.description: Key phrases get a highlighter stroke, drawn as you read past them.

reference.title: Giant sliding lines
reference.description: Two oversized lines cross the screen in opposite directions.

reference.title: Weight wave
reference.description: A variable font: a band of heavy weight travels through the word as you scroll.

reference.title: Grow to full screen
reference.description: A small card opens up until it fills the viewport.

reference.title: Shrink away
reference.description: The reverse: a full-bleed scene shrinks into a rounded card.

reference.title: Colour journey
reference.description: One panel travels through the palette; the text inverts to stay readable.

reference.title: Fisheye list
reference.description: Items swell as they reach the middle of the screen and shrink as they leave.

reference.title: Hue shift
reference.description: The same image cycles through hues as it scrolls past.

reference.title: Flip-down cards
reference.description: Cards swing down into place like a split-flap board.

reference.title: Bars that grow + line that draws
reference.description: Bars rise and count up; a line draws itself and a marker reads the value under it. Both use Genially’s real creation numbers.

reference.title: Donut + gauge
reference.description: Segments sweep in and a needle swings to its reading, both scrubbed.

reference.title: Pictogram
reference.description: A hundred figures; scroll colours in how many of them are teachers.

reference.title: Rearranging scatter
reference.description: The same 60 dots regroup three times as the story moves on: a cloud, then clusters, then a ranking.

reference.title: Bar chart race
reference.description: Scroll is the clock: bars grow and swap places quarter by quarter. Real numbers: watch games overtake presentations.

reference.title: KPI tiles that count up
reference.description: Sometimes the best chart is a number. Tiles count up once when they arrive, with the change beside them.

reference.title: Treemap
reference.description: Areas sized by value, packed into one rectangle. Tiles grow in from their corner, biggest first.

reference.title: Bubble pack
reference.description: The same numbers as circles that pop in and settle. Good when exact comparison matters less than the overall feel.

reference.title: Sunburst
reference.description: A two-ring hierarchy: formats inside, quarters outside. Rings sweep open in order as you scroll.

reference.title: Streamgraph
reference.description: Stacked layers around a flowing centre line, revealed left to right by scroll.

reference.title: Slope chart
reference.description: Two moments, one line per series: the angle is the story. Lines draw in, then labels land.

reference.title: Dumbbell
reference.description: Start and end on one row. The end dot slides away from the start as you scroll.

reference.title: Lollipop
reference.description: A lighter bar chart: thin stems grow, then the heads pop.

reference.title: Waterfall
reference.description: Week-over-week change: rises step up, falls step down, from the first week to the last.

reference.title: Radial bars
reference.description: Twelve weeks around a clock face. Columns grow outward in order.

reference.title: Small multiples
reference.description: One small chart per format, each with its own scale, so you compare shapes, not sizes.

reference.title: Annotated line, pinned
reference.description: The chart stays put while the line draws; notes appear when the line reaches them.

reference.title: Network of this Lab
reference.description: Every category and library in this page, linked by how many effects they share. Built live from the Lab’s own tags.

reference.title: Heatmap
reference.description: Activity by weekday and hour. Cells light up in a diagonal wave.

reference.title: Beeswarm
reference.description: Every dot is one lesson, placed by completion rate. Dots drop in and settle without overlapping.

reference.title: Ridgeline
reference.description: Distributions stacked like hills; each one rises from its baseline.

reference.title: Radar that morphs, pinned
reference.description: Scroll moves one shape through three formats, so you see what changes.

reference.title: Gantt with a moving today line
reference.description: A course build plan. Bars grow in order and a today line sweeps with scroll; tasks it passes turn done.

reference.title: Poster camera timeline
reference.description: Two weeks in the life of one genially, as a road with seven stops. The camera flies stop to stop, the road fills up to each one, and each stop opens its own small chart. At the end it pulls back to show the whole journey.

reference.title: Horizontal progress line
reference.description: Pinned; the line fills and each node lights as the fill passes it.

reference.title: Sticky year counter
reference.description: The year stays put and rolls to each entry as it passes.

reference.title: Clock dial
reference.description: A day of clicks on a dial. Scroll turns the hand; the arc fills and the hour changes.

reference.title: Snapping horizontal panels
reference.description: Four full-width panels slide sideways and settle on the nearest one when you stop.

reference.title: Opposite columns
reference.description: The left column rises while the right one falls.

reference.title: Stacking panels
reference.description: Each panel sticks, the next slides over it, and the one underneath sinks back.

reference.title: Parallax gallery
reference.description: Three columns of images, each moving at its own speed.

reference.title: Deep zoom
reference.description: Scroll pushes into one image, from the whole cabinet down to a single gear.

reference.title: Ken Burns sequence
reference.description: Stills slowly pan and zoom, crossfading from one to the next.

reference.title: Image-sequence scrub
reference.description: 72 still frames on a canvas. Lighter than video, every frame exact.

reference.title: Plays when seen
reference.description: The film plays on its own while it is on screen and pauses when it leaves. You can stop it.

reference.title: Spotlight reveal
reference.description: The pointer is a torch: it cuts a hole in the top layer to show the one underneath.

reference.title: Magnetic buttons
reference.description: Buttons lean toward the pointer before you reach them.

reference.title: 3D tilt + glare
reference.description: Cards tip toward the pointer with a moving highlight; the label floats above.

reference.title: Image trail
reference.description: Move across the box and stills spill out behind the pointer.

reference.title: Rolling links
reference.description: On hover each letter rolls up to reveal a coral copy.
reference.code:
/* CSS */
.rolls{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:40px 20px;display:grid;gap:4px}

reference.title: Click burst
reference.description: Every click throws confetti from the point you clicked.

reference.title: Throwable stickers
reference.description: Drag and fling them; they glide to a stop inside the box.

reference.title: Hover list with preview
reference.description: Hover a row and its picture follows the pointer.

reference.title: Grid ↔ list
reference.description: Switch the layout and every card glides to its new place.

reference.title: Context cursor
reference.description: The cursor on this page changes size and label with what it is over. Here it becomes a big lens.
reference.code:
/* CSS */
.curzone{height:300px;border-radius:22px;background:var(--pink);color:var(--night);display:grid;place-items:center;font:800 clamp(30px,5vw,64px)/1 var(--display);letter-spacing:-.04em}
